items.description: Build the marketing landing page as the new / route and move the current app homepage to /read, replicating the approved artifact design (workspace/your_files/enoch-wiki-landing-page/enoch-wiki-landing-page.html). Sections: header (wordmark, nav: The app -> /read, How we vet -> /how-we-vet, Vision -> #vision, FAQ -> #faq, CTA 'Open app ->' -> /read, nowrap), hero (eyebrow 'The Ethiopian Bible, corroborated', H1 'What the text says. And how we know.' with italic accent, sub copy, CTAs 'Start reading ->' -> /read and 'See how we vet' -> /how-we-vet, app mock panel), certainty strip (6 tier chips), 01 THE APP (5 feature cards with 3-item includes lists), 02 HOW WE VET (3-stage pipeline, review rubric, source tiers), 03 VISION (Garima Gospels image with caption + alt text, pull quote, purpose triad), FAQ accordion, closing CTA band ('Open app ->'), footer. Move src/app/page.tsx to src/app/read/page.tsx; update SiteHeader (logo -> /, Open app -> /read), MobileBottomNav Read tab -> /read, sitemap.ts (add / with priority, keep existing entries). Save the Garima image under public/images/ (extract from the artifact export or Wikimedia Commons; keep the attribution caption). SEO: metadata title/description/OG on /, one h1, semantic heading order, server-rendered. Brand: repo theme tokens (parchment, antique gold, indigo, serif); works in light and dark mode. HARD CONSTRAINTS: zero emdashes (—) in any new/changed copy — rewrite with commas, colons, periods, or parentheses; tighten copy for brevity without dropping verified claims. Copy claims must match the real app only (reader, search, Knowledge Graph, Timeline, Themes, Study Tools, AI companion via /api/chat + /api/summarize, three-layer pipeline, tiers). Render and eyeball at 390px and 1440px: no overflow, no wrapped CTA, no dead space, visible focus, working anchors, 44px+ touch targets. Run bash scripts/check.sh to ALL GATES PASS.
items.regression_notes: Re-run if routes or header nav change. The /read move must keep ?panel=explore deep links and mobile bottom nav working. If the Garima image download fails, extract it from the artifact export instead of hotlinking.
steps: Read the artifact HTML at workspace/your_files/enoch-wiki-landing-page/enoch-wiki-landing-page.html and the repo theme tokens (tailwind.config.ts, src/app/globals.css).
Move src/app/page.tsx to src/app/read/page.tsx; verify ?panel=explore and mobile nav still work at /read.
Build the landing page at src/app/page.tsx (+ src/components/landing/ as needed) replicating the artifact sections, with no emdashes and tightened copy.
Update SiteHeader, MobileBottomNav, sitemap.ts; add page metadata; save the Garima image to public/images/ with alt text.
Screenshot at 390px and 1440px; fix overflow, wrapping, dead space, contrast, heading order, anchors, touch targets.
bash scripts/check.sh must end ALL GATES PASS. Grep the diff for — (must be zero in new/changed copy).

objective: Ship the Mobbin-grounded landing page as the SEO front door at /, move the app homepage to /read. No emdashes, brief copy, verified claims only, all gates pass.
